body.intent: rhiza check builds the as-is model once and each in-flight change set's what-if once (model.AsIsState and model.WhatIfFrom), shared between its two passes, and store.ReadEntries decodes the log on several cores, so check on this repo takes seconds, not 15. Evidence: check calls model.WhatIf twice per in-flight change set (internal/check/check.go:384 and :456), about 96 as-is rebuilds, over a serial decode of 127 MB (internal/store/read.go:97); not yet profiled.
body.title: Check without what-if rebuilds
